s1.p1: These Terms of Service set out the rules for using the website available at weunite.pl (the "Site") and the terms on which WeUnite, based at ul. Gdyńska G/9, 80-340 Gdańsk, Poland (the "Service Provider" or "WeUnite"), provides services by electronic means.
s1.p2: Service Provider contact details: email <email>info@weunite.pl</email>, phone +48 537 732 320.
s1.p3: Using the Site means you accept these Terms of Service. If you do not agree with these provisions, please do not use the Site.

items: Site — the website available at weunite.pl, together with all its subpages.
User — any natural person, legal person, or unincorporated organizational unit using the Site.
Lead / Form — the contact form allowing a User to sign up for a free consultation and website mockup.
Booking system — the built-in calendar that lets a User independently choose a time for a strategy call.
Services — the services provided by WeUnite, in particular: building websites with booking and payment systems, social media management, and business automations.
GDPR — Regulation (EU) 2016/679 of the European Parliament and of the Council of 27 April 2016 on the protection of natural persons with regard to the processing of personal data.

s3.title: § 3. Type and scope of electronic services
s3.intro: Through the Site, WeUnite provides the following electronic services:
items: Providing the contact form (Lead) — allowing a User to submit their details in order to receive a free consultation and website mockup.
An automatic email sequence — after filling out the form, the User receives a series of emails (Day 0 / Day 2 / Day 4) containing information about the Services and an invitation to book a call.
A strategy call booking system — allowing the User to independently choose an available time slot and receive a confirmation and reminders (48h / 24h / 1h before the call).
Presentation of our services — information about WeUnite's Services, case studies, and references.
s3.p1: The services listed above are free of charge. Any paid services (project delivery) are governed by a separate agreement between WeUnite and the client.

s4.intro1: To use the Site, the User needs:
items1: a device with internet access (computer, tablet, smartphone),

an active email address (if using the form or booking system).

refrain from any action that could disrupt the Site's proper functioning,
